text:
The HepaProtect vaccine demonstrates a high efficacy rate of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection specifically within the demographic of healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. Regarding suitability for other groups, the provided text does not offer data on efficacy for children, the elderly, or individuals with compromised immune systems, so its suitability for those populations cannot be determined from this information alone. However, the vaccine is contraindicated for individuals with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any of the vaccine components, as they should avoid it.
